blocking.title: D4 class 'files that steer agents' misses AGENTS.override.md and .pi/skills/**, which pacman's own pi backend loads ahead of or beside AGENTS.md, so such a PR routes to auto-merge
blocking.failurePath: Input: a PR whose only change is adding a root AGENTS.override.md, for example AGENTS.md with the tests-first or no-force-push rules removed. The caller passes changedFiles ['AGENTS.override.md'], deletedFiles [] and linesChanged under 800. isProtected('AGENTS.override.md') is false (line 73), because '**/AGENTS.md' compiles to ^(?:.*/)?AGENTS\.md$. So matchedProtected = [] (line 109). Unless a reviewer happens to volunteer the path in protectedPaths, humanReasons = [] and mergedBy = 'auto-merge' (line 330). spec 28 D7 and the §7.3/§7.4 prompts then enable `gh pr merge --squash --auto`. After the merge, the pi engine reads context files first-wins in the order AGENTS.override.md > AGENTS.md > AGENTS.MD > CLAUDE.md > CLAUDE.MD (pi-coding-agent dist/core/resource-loader.js:116, copied into packages/shared/src/brief-file.ts:39-42). Every pi-backed pacman agent in a xiechimon/pacman worktree therefore stops loading AGENTS.md. resolveBriefTarget (brief-file.ts:98-101) then appends the run brief into the override file. The same gap exists for .pi/skills/**: runner.ts:832 passes piWorktreeSkillDirs(cwd) = [<wt>/.claude/skills, <wt>/.pi/skills] (skills.ts:389-391) into the pi catalog, and '.pi/**' is not in PROTECTED. Root .claude/** is protected; .pi/skills is not. This contradicts ADR 0021 D4 ① ('左右 agent 的文件'), the header comment at lines 25-28 ('The paths are classes, not names, at any depth') and the stated reason for the gate: a PR must not change what steers the agents that build the next PRs. The same root-anchoring also leaves nested apps/*/.claude/skills/** (directory-scoped skills, which the head .gitignore does not ignore) open.
blocking.evidence: Probe of the head's PROTECTED/globToRegExp/isProtected: 'open' for AGENTS.override.md, apps/server/.claude/skills/verify-pacman/SKILL.md and apps/web/.claude/skills/pr-pacman/SKILL.md; 'PROT' for .claude/workflows/pr-gate.js and .husky/pre-commit. `git check-ignore` with the head .gitignore reports apps/server/.claude/skills/verify-pacman/SKILL.md as not ignored, so it can be committed. Fix: add '**/AGENTS.override.md' (or '**/AGENTS*.md' plus '**/CLAUDE*.md' to catch case variants) and '**/.pi/**', make '.claude/**' read '**/.claude/**', add the matching self-check cases, and mirror the change in ADR 0021 D4.
skeptics:
Confirmed at 37674a9b. In .claude/workflows/pr-gate.js, PROTECTED (lines 30-52) lists '**/AGENTS.md' and a root-anchored '.claude/**', but has no entry for AGENTS.override.md, .pi/** or a nested .claude/**. globToRegExp compiles '**/AGENTS.md' to ^(?:.*/)?AGENTS\.md$. A standalone probe of the head's PROTECTED and isProtected returns open for AGENTS.override.md, AGENTS.MD, CLAUDE.MD, .pi/skills/x/SKILL.md and apps/server/.claude/skills/verify-pacman/SKILL.md. It returns PROT for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and .claude/workflows/pr-gate.js.

I ran the head gate script end to end with stub agents in the same harness shape as scripts/pr-gate-selfcheck.mjs. Every reviewer returned no findings, and the safety reviewer returned the same file list. Results:
- ['AGENTS.override.md'] gives go=true, mergedBy='auto-merge', protectedPaths=[].
- ['.pi/skills/evil/SKILL.md'] and ['apps/web/.claude/skills/x/SKILL.md'] give the same result.
- The control ['AGENTS.md'] gives mergedBy='user'.

Routing to the user therefore depends on an LLM reviewer volunteering the path, which is what the header comment at lines 25-28 says the code avoids.

These files do steer agents:
- The installed @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.0.4 dist/core/resource-loader.js loadContextFileFromDir uses candidates ["AGENTS.override.md","AGENTS.md","AGENTS.MD","CLAUDE.md","CLAUDE.MD"] with first-wins existsSync. packages/shared/src/brief-file.ts:39-42 copies that order, and resolveBriefTarget appends the run brief to the first match, so the override file wins.
- apps/daemon/src/backend/skills.ts:389-391 piWorktreeSkillDirs returns [<cwd>/.claude/skills, <cwd>/.pi/skills], and runner.ts:832 and backend/pi.ts:950,1170 use it. So <worktree>/.pi/skills is loaded into the pi skill catalog.
- The head .gitignore anchors '.claude/*' at the root and has no .pi entry, so nested .claude/skills and .pi/skills can be committed.

Spec 28 line 9 and line 140 describe the pacman instance working on xiechimon/pacman worktrees with its engine reading AGENTS.md natively. Spec 28 D7 and the §7.3/§7.4 prompts enable auto-merge when mergedBy is not 'user'. ADR 0021 D4 ① defines the class as files that steer agents at any depth ('保护的是类别…按文件名点名总会漏'), and these paths fall in that class but are not matched. The failure path is real.

Private refs refs/pr-gate/1410/correctness-refute-0/{base,head} were deleted. The probe files are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-pacman/219f57bb-8cc6-5f6d-bbc7-09aaf28f3ace/scratchpad/probe/.

I confirmed the failure at 37674a9. In .claude/workflows/pr-gate.js, PROTECTED (lines 29-50) holds '**/AGENTS.md' and '**/CLAUDE.md' but no AGENTS.override.md, no '.pi/**', and only a root-anchored '.claude/**'. globToRegExp (lines 52-70) builds exact-name regexes. I took the head's PROTECTED, globToRegExp and isProtected verbatim and ran them under node. Results: AGENTS.override.md, AGENTS.MD, CLAUDE.MD, .pi/skills/x/SKILL.md and apps/server/.claude/skills/verify-pacman/SKILL.md come back 'open'. AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/workflows/pr-gate.js and .husky/pre-commit come back 'PROT'. So for changedFiles ['AGENTS.override.md'], matchedProtected is []. If no reviewer adds the path to protectedPaths, and lines and files stay under the limits with no deleted tests, humanReasons is [] and mergedBy is 'auto-merge' (line 330). spec 28 D7 and the line 208/232 flow at the head then turn on `gh pr merge --squash --auto`. These files do steer agents: the installed pi-coding-agent 1.0.4 dist/core/resource-loader.js loadContextFileFromDir reads candidates first-wins in the order ['AGENTS.override.md','AGENTS.md','AGENTS.MD','CLAUDE.md','CLAUDE.MD']. packages/shared/src/brief-file.ts at the head copies that order into BRIEF_CANDIDATES.pi, and resolveBriefTarget appends to the first match. So a root AGENTS.override.md takes the place of AGENTS.md for pacman's pi-backed agents. In the same way, runner.ts:832 calls piWorktreeSkillDirs(cwd), which skills.ts:389-391 defines as [<cwd>/.claude/skills, <cwd>/.pi/skills], and those directories feed the pi skill catalog and the Skill tool. That makes .pi/skills/** an agent-steering path that the gate does not protect. ADR 0021 D4 (1) at the head says it protects the class of files that steer agents, at any directory depth ('**/' includes the root). The header comment at lines 25-28 says the same. The code does not match that.

suggestions.title: Auto-merge is not pinned to the head pr-gate judged, so a later push merges without a new gate run
suggestions.failurePath: The flow in §7.3/§7.4 and D7 is: run pr-gate, and on go with the gated headSha equal to the PR head, enable auto-merge. The §7.4 prompt also tells the session to run update-branch on BEHIND and to fix CI red. Neither `gh pr merge --squash --auto` nor auto-merge through the GitHub tool binds the head SHA. Auto-merge stays armed when a writer with push access adds commits. So a push after auto-merge is enabled (an update-branch merge commit, or a CI fix) is merged once checks go green, and pr-gate never sees that head. pr-gate.js:16 and §7.5 require that the merge happen only on the gated headSha. Passing `--match-head-commit <headSha>` when enabling auto-merge, or disabling auto-merge before any later push and re-gating, would close this gap.
suggestions.evidence: spec 28 lines 208, 232 and 246; pr-gate.js:16 ('The caller merges only when go is true and headSha equals the PR head').

suggestions.title: The safety reviewer does see part of the caller's list, contrary to spec 28 §7.5 and the PR body
suggestions.failurePath: readRules('safety', false) leaves out changedFiles. But the safety prompt embeds JSON.stringify(matchedProtected), which is caller-derived. spec 28 line 254 says '安全维度不看调用方的清单', and the PR body says the reviewer takes all three 'without seeing the caller's list'. The reviewer's changedFiles still comes from git, so routing is not affected. The claim is stronger than the code, and the shown subset can anchor the reviewer's protectedPaths on the caller's view.

suggestions.title: pr and ticket are not checked as positive integers
suggestions.failurePath: typeof args.pr === 'number' accepts 1410.5, -3 or 0. These values are interpolated into ref names and gh api paths (refs/pull/1410.5/head, issues/-3). The result is a confusing no-go from failed fetches instead of an args error. Number.isInteger(x) && x > 0 matches what linesChanged already gets.

suggestions.title: AGENTS.md's squash procedure lands a commit on this PR with no closing line and no ticket in the subject
suggestions.failurePath: Three commits on the branch (ca088ce, 3944905, 662cbd9) have subjects `docs: spec 28 ...` with no `(<ticket>)`. The first of them carries no closing keyword. AGENTS.md (Git, squash rule) tells a CLI merger to take `gh api repos/xiechimon/pacman/pulls/<n>/commits -q '.[0].commit.message'` as the squash subject and body. ADR 0021 D2 (line 35) repeats that human CLI merges follow 'AGENTS.md 的 squash 取法'. For #1410, `.[0]` is ca088ce: `docs: spec 28 自举闭环计划（...）`, and `grep -ci 'closes #'` on that message gives 0. A merger who follows the documented procedure therefore puts a subject with no ticket on main and leaves #1401 OPEN, which is the closing failure AGENTS.md was written to prevent. Two things soften this. The repo's GitHub UI default (COMMIT_MESSAGES) includes e5414a2's `closes #1401`, and the PR body's Issues section warns the merger. That is why this is a suggestion. Two cheap fixes: have the last commit's message carry `closes #1401` as well, or reword the three early subjects (`docs(1401): ...`). Either way, D2 should not send multi-commit PRs to the `.[0]` procedure.
suggestions.evidence: gh api repos/xiechimon/pacman/pulls/1410/commits --jq '.[0]' -> ca088ce 'docs: spec 28 自举闭环计划（pacman 自写 PR、自合 PR，goal 模式执行）'. `closes #1401` appears only in e5414a2 (4th commit). Repo squash_merge_commit_message=COMMIT_MESSAGES.

suggestions.title: pr-gate breaks docs/pr-review.md's hard rules, but pr-review.md does not record the exception
suggestions.failurePath: AGENTS.md says to review PRs by docs/pr-review.md and calls 「不切分支看 diff」 a hard rule. pr-review.md step 4 says 绝不 gh pr checkout、绝不 git switch and 评审是只读动作，不改变任何工作区状态. Step 1 requires the `inprogress` label, and the verdict goes out as a six-section scorecard in a PR comment. pr-gate.js departs from all of this. Line 143 has the evidence reviewer and its skeptics run `git checkout --detach` in a worktree of their own. Line 119 forbids labels and comments. The verdict is a JSON schema (lines 147-191), not the scorecard. The carve-out is written only inside the prompt text ('docs/pr-review.md step 4 forbids it in the shared clone, not here') and in spec 28 §7.5. A reviewer or agent that reads pr-review.md, the canonical procedure, sees no exception, and the next edit to either file can drift without anyone noticing. pr-review.md step 5 and the rules list ask for documents to change with the behavior. A short pr-review.md note naming pr-gate as the machine path and its worktree, read-only and JSON differences would keep the canonical rule in step. That note is a D4 path, but this PR already routes to the user.
suggestions.evidence: docs/pr-review.md step 4 and step 1 at main. pr-gate.js:119 (GitHub read-only), :143 (checkout --detach in a worktree), :233 (skeptics inherit isolation). spec 28 line 246/254 is the only other place the exception is stated.

suggestions.title: Selfcheck never has a skeptic confirm a finding, so the core withdraw condition (both refute) is unguarded
suggestions.failurePath: pr-gate.js:245 withdraws a blocking finding when `answered.length === 2 && answered.every((v) => v.refuted)`. Every selfcheck case that reaches this branch with two answers on HEAD uses refuted:true: the 'two skeptics refuting' case, the cap case, and the stub default at selfcheck line 28, which returns refuted:true. No case has a skeptic answer refuted:false on HEAD. If line 245 is edited to `if (answered.length === 2)` (ignore the votes), the selfcheck still prints 26/26 and CI stays green. Yet with two skeptics who both confirm the bug (refuted:false on HEAD), that gate returns go:true with blocking:[]. The head copy correctly returns go:false with blocking 1. The selfcheck header (line 3) and spec 28 §7.5 both say the 'skeptic withdraw rule' is checked. Add cases for both-confirm and split votes (refute plus confirm on HEAD) and assert the finding is kept and go is false.
suggestions.evidence: Local mutation: the head gate patched so line 245 reads `answered.length === 2` gives '26/26 passed'. Extra probe with votes [confirm, confirm]: head gives go false, blocking 1; mutant gives go true, blocking 0. Same result with [refute, confirm].

suggestions.title: Rename case cannot tell whether unlisted files take part in D4 matching
suggestions.failurePath: The 'rename out of a protected path' case passes changedFiles ['biome.jsonc'], and biome.jsonc is itself protected (`**/biome.jsonc`). So mergedBy is 'user' whether or not pr-gate.js:294 (`...unlistedFiles.filter(isProtected)`) runs. Removing that line keeps 26/26. Take a caller list ['apps/x.ts'] and a safety list that adds '.github/workflows/ci.yml'. With the line removed, the gate returns mergedBy 'auto-merge' for a CI-file change. go is still false through unlistedFiles, so nothing merges today. But spec 28 §7.5 says unlisted paths also take part in the matching, and the test does not hold that. Use a non-protected new name, for example a rename of biome.json to apps/x.json, and assert protectedPaths includes the old name.

suggestions.title: Deleted-test detection and the deletedFiles subset check have untested branches
suggestions.failurePath: pr-gate.js:301-303 treats a file as a deleted test if it matches either of two regexes: a test directory (e2e/test/tests/__tests__) or a *.test/*.spec suffix. Both deletion cases ('apps/server/test/foo.test.ts' and 'apps/web/e2e/board.spec.ts') match both regexes. Dropping either regex keeps 26/26. Without the directory regex, a deleted helper such as 'integration/test/helpers.ts' would no longer route to the user. Without the suffix regex, a deleted colocated 'apps/web/src/x.test.tsx' would no longer route to the user. Separately, the args check `deletedFiles.every(f => changedFiles.includes(f))` (pr-gate.js:94) has no case, so removing it keeps 26/26. Add one deletion per regex, and an args case with a deleted path missing from changedFiles.
suggestions.evidence: Mutations removing each regex in turn, and removing line 94, each give 26/26.

suggestions.title: §8 ledger ticks P0 done before the user merge that P0's acceptance requires
suggestions.failurePath: spec 28 line 86 sets P0 acceptance as 'ADR 0021 由用户合并（D7）', and ticket #1401's last item is '本票 PR 由用户合并（D7）'. The P0 row on this branch already reads '[x]'. Ticket failure mode 4 says the ledger is what a resumed session reads after compaction. A goal session resumed on this branch before the merge, or after a change request, would read P0 as complete while #1410 is open. Leave the box empty or write a pending marker, and tick it in the follow-up that records the merge.
suggestions.evidence: Ledger row at line 265 ends with '| 用户 | [x] |'. PR #1410 state is open, and the PR body says the merge item is not a task box.

suggestions.title: Evidence dimension runs PR-quoted commands and pnpm install at the PR head with session credentials, with no guard in code
suggestions.failurePath: The input is pr-gate called on a PR the session did not write, for example a fork PR, since refs/pull/N/head fetches forks too (line 117). Its Verified section quotes `node scripts/x.mjs`, or its root package.json `prepare` is changed. The evidence agent runs `git checkout --detach <head>`, then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, which runs the root lifecycle scripts, and then the quoted commands. The result is author-controlled code running with this session's GitHub credentials. Spec 28 §7.5 line 255 limits pr-gate to this session's PRs and says to turn off the re-run before reviewing an external PR. The script has no switch to do that and no check of head.repo.full_name or author, so the limit holds only by caller discipline.
suggestions.evidence: pr-gate.js:143 'Re-run at most three of the narrowest commands quoted in the PR's Verified section ... after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`'. spec 28 line 255: '只对本会话施工的 PR 跑 pr-gate；评外部 PR 前先关掉这一维的复跑'. No args field or condition disables it. Suggested fix: refuse, or skip the re-run, when `gh api repos/xiechimon/pacman/pulls/<pr>` shows head.repo.full_name != REPO or an author other than the session's account. Or add an explicit args.rerun flag.

suggestions.title: D4 glob matching is case-sensitive, so case variants of protected paths route to auto-merge
suggestions.failurePath: globToRegExp builds `new RegExp(`^${re}$`)` with no 'i' flag. With the head script and stub agents, each of changedFiles ['.Claude/settings.json'], ['.Husky/pre-commit'], ['apps/web/Claude.md'] and ['Scripts/x.mjs'] returns go:true, mergedBy:'auto-merge' and protectedPaths []. Spec 28 §7.2 recommends running on the Mac, where APFS is case-insensitive by default. There `.Claude/` and `.claude/` are the same directory, so after a pull a merged case-variant file can land on the protected file. Whether it does depends on the checkout order, so I did not trace it to a certain wrong outcome. Adding the 'i' flag at line 70 closes the class at no cost.
suggestions.evidence: Probe output: [".Claude/settings.json"] -> true auto-merge []; [".Husky/pre-commit"] -> true auto-merge []; ["apps/web/Claude.md"] -> true auto-merge []; ["Scripts/x.mjs"] -> true auto-merge []

suggestions.title: D4 class list misses some files that steer agents: .cursor/skills, .ckignore and the spec 28 runbook
suggestions.failurePath:
ADR 0021 D4 ① protects 'files that steer agents' by class. Three such files are not covered.
- The repo tracks .cursor/skills/verify-pacman/SKILL.md and features/. Only its scripts/ match **/scripts/**.
- .ckignore is the allowlist of the local scout-block hook that decides what agent tools may read.
- spec 28 is the runbook the goal session obeys: §3 says '只按这里写定的裁决施工', and it holds the D7 merge routing and the §7.5 rule to run the origin/main copy through scriptPath.
Each of these files on its own comes out go:true, mergedBy:auto-merge with the head script. So a later bootstrap PR that loosens D7, or changes §7.5 to named invocation, would be judged auto-mergeable. On this PR it changes nothing, because the PR already routes to the user. I added docs/spec/28 to protectedPaths. Naming these files in ADR 0021 D4 and in PROTECTED would close the gap for later PRs.
suggestions.evidence: git ls-tree at head: .cursor/skills/verify-pacman/{SKILL.md,features,scripts/glass.mjs} and .ckignore ('自定义放行——补 scout-block baseline 的过度拦'). Probe: .cursor/skills/verify-pacman/SKILL.md, .ckignore and docs/spec/28-bootstrap-closed-loop-self-authored-self-merged.md each give true auto-merge [].

suggestions.title: UNSAFE_PATH lets quote and whitespace characters through to agents that build git commands
suggestions.failurePath: Line 83 says file names reach agents that build git commands from them. UNSAFE_PATH rejects control characters and `$;|&<>\. It accepts single quote, space, ( ) * ? [ ] ! # ~. Consider a PR path such as `x' --output=.git/hooks/post-checkout 'y`. An agent that single-quotes paths in `git show <sha>:'<path>'` would turn it into extra git options. This needs a particular quoting habit in the agent, so it is a hardening note, not a traced failure. Allow-listing path characters (for example `[\p{L}\p{N}._/@+-]`) and rejecting everything else would close it.

suggestions.title: New CI step and self-check script are outside ticket #1401's listed scope
suggestions.failurePath: Ticket #1401's scope lists ADR 0021, the ADR 0018 pointer, spec 28, P1-P8 tickets and storing the pr-gate workflow. The PR also adds scripts/pr-gate-selfcheck.mjs and a step in the `check` job. Per ADR 0021 F6, `check` is a required status check on main, so every later PR to main now needs this self-check to pass. The PR body discloses the change and D4 routes it to the user. It could be added to the ticket's scope so that the ledger and the ticket agree.
suggestions.evidence: ci.yml +165 'name: pr-gate self-check (#1401) / run: node scripts/pr-gate-selfcheck.mjs'. Ticket #1401 '范围' has no CI item.
